assessment: This study provides important findings on the discovery of a novel CRM1 inhibitor. This study provides compelling data on the identification of a novel CRM1 inhibitor and shows its efficiency against extranodal natural killer/T cell lymphoma cells (ENKTL). The findings from this study will provide motivation on optimizing these novel CRM inhibitors for treatments of ENKTL and will be of broad interest to cancer biology.
